title: Contents Packout & Storage Closing Payment: Work Above the Approved Contents Scope
content:
**Rule.** For the closing payment on an insurance-funded Contents Packout & Storage job, the carrier pays contents work only up to the contents scope it approved, and approves storage separately by date: the contents work charged is every charge line on the job other than storage, declared-value coverage, card surcharge and late fee lines, and the approved contents scope is the total of the carrier's contents-coverage scope approvals on the linked claim file, and the most recent supplement request of a reason is the one of that reason carrying the highest supplement number on the file; when the claim file is in approved or settled status and the most recent contents added supplement request on its contents coverage is named by no carrier approval, the closing payment carries the contents work charged less the approved contents scope less the amount that request asks for, never below zero; when the claim file is in approved or settled status, no such request awaits a decision and more days than the arrangement's supplement window have passed since the carrier's initial approval date, it carries the contents work charged less the approved contents scope, never below zero; in every other case nothing is added.

**Records.** The job's charge lines; and, on the Insurance Claim Services claim file linked to the job, its status, its contents-coverage scope approvals, its contents added supplement requests on the contents coverage with their supplement numbers and requested amounts, the carrier approvals naming them, the initial approval date and the supplement window of the file's billing arrangement.

**Branches.**

- *Approved or settled, most recent contents added request undecided:* contents work charged, less approved contents scope, less that request's amount, never below zero.
- *Approved or settled, no such request awaiting a decision, more days than the supplement window since initial approval:* contents work charged less approved contents scope, never below zero.
- *Every other case:* nothing is added.

**Cases (hypothetical figures).** Work charged 9,150.00 and approved scope 8,000.00 with an undecided request for 400.00: 750.00. With the request decided and 95 days since initial approval under a 90-day window: 1,150.00. At 90 days exactly under that window: nothing, since more days than the window must have passed.
